tools.name: create_note
tools.title: create note
tools.description: Create a NoteX note, optionally with rich-text blocks and existing tags.

format.description: Use text for literal plain text or html for supported NoteX rich text.

value.description: For html, supported inline elements are <strong>, <em>, <u>, <s>, <code>, <a href="...">, <span style="color: ...">, and <mark style="background-color: ...">. Prefer NoteX palette colors as var(--nx-color-NAME), where NAME is red, rose, pink, fuchsia, purple, violet, indigo, blue, sky, cyan, teal, mint, green, lime, yellow, amber, orange, brown, slate, or neutral. For a palette highlight, use color-mix(in srgb, var(--nx-color-NAME) 28%, transparent).

title.description: Title of the new note. Omit to create an empty note title.
